english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for both the pumpkin plant and its fruit.
Use this for the squash vegetable itself or for squash served as a dish; Cantonese does not usually mark that distinction in the noun.

examples.english: This pumpkin makes very sweet soup.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 naam4 gwaa1 bou1 tong1 hou2 tim4

examples.english: This squash is cooked really soft.
examples.jyutping: ni1 dip6 naam4 gwaa1 bou1 dak1 hou2 nam4
